name: app-event-splits-phone-in-flower-meadow
title: Event App in a Flower Meadow
whatItIs: A large white-UI phone standing in a photographic flower meadow under a bright blue sky, showing an event feed with a picnic photo and split-payment cards, beside a curved chrome object.
whatItMeans: The sunny outdoor setting matches the social events theme, making the app feel joyful and open.
techniques: Oversized phone integrated into a natural landscape
Photo card inside the UI echoing the surrounding picnic mood
Chrome curved prop as a surreal accent
Clean white UI to contrast with vivid greens and blues
Dark floating tab bar with a red-orange plus button

vocabulary.definition: Objects shown at impossible sizes within a scene.
A feature dividing a cost among people.
A dark rounded navigation bar hovering over content.
